influences.name: Danny Elfman
influences.context: Danny Elfman's film scores were a significant influence for her when she began creating Evanescence's music.

influences.name: Hans Zimmer
influences.context: Lee's musical influences throughout childhood and her teenage years included classical music, Danny Elfman and Hans Zimmer's film scores

influences.name: Bach
influences.context: Her earliest memory of wanting to fuse various and contrasting musical styles, was when she was training in classical piano and realized that a section of a composition from Baroque composer Bach resembled heavy metal.

influences.name: Mozart
influences.context: Lee considers the Lacrimosa movement of Mozart's Requiem her favorite piece of music, and wove it into The Open Door song 'Lacrymosa'.

influences.name: Björk
influences.context: Lee's musical influences throughout childhood and her teenage years included classical music, Danny Elfman and Hans Zimmer's film scores, alternative music, grunge, hard rock, industrial music, death metal, groove metal, and electronica artists like Björk and Portishead.

influences.name: The Cure
influences.context: Jonathan Davis and Amy Lee on MTV Unplugged: Jonathan was saying how it was such an honor to have Robert Smith on the show because they were who he really was inspired by in high school; and I said 'that's what you guys were for me'.

influences.name: Ozzy Osbourne
influences.context: [Ozzy's] one of the people that pushed, you know, the darkness forward and made that cool, made that something that was possible and provocative

influences.name: Black Sabbath
influences.context: That's a forever band that's just always going to be there. It's such a huge part of rock and roll.

influences.name: David Campbell
influences.context: I think [string arranger] David Campbell, and all that he brought to the table, was one of the key elements that made Fallen, and everything we've been fortunate enough to create since, what it is.
